card.name: Final pieces of split words and numbers
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word or number that was split into parts, such as the end of 'sepia', 'globulin', or a year or large number. It fires where the item is nearly complete and the next token is a separate word or punctuation.

modes.label: Ends of split words
modes.description: The final piece of a longer word broken into parts, such as sepia, intestine, or globulin.
modes.example: Estrogens tend to increase serum thyroxine-binding glob<<ulin>> (TBg).

modes.label: Last digit of numbers
modes.description: The last digit of a year or a rounded number like 500.

card.plain: It marks the point where a long word or number has just been completed.
